afshar-2017.title: Efficient electrochemical model for lithium-ion cells
afshar-2017.role: Scientific attribution supplied by the upstream implementation; original equation not independently checked.

chen-2020.title: Development of Experimental Techniques for Parameterization of Multi-scale Lithium-ion Battery Models
chen-2020.role: Scientific attribution of the LG M50 graphite OCP and non-OCP parameter implementations; individual measurement/fit/borrowing origins not independently audited.

pybamm-25-4-2.title: PyBaMM v25.4.2: pinned lithium-ion parameter implementations
pybamm-25-4-2.role: Redistributable software distribution for Prada2013, Chen2020, Marquis2019, Mohtat2020 and NCA_Kim2011. Scientific origin is recorded per function; shared software does not establish shared measurement origin. Prada2013 borrows its OCPs from Afshar2017 and Chen2020. Ecker2015 and Ai2020 modules are also pinned; original and borrowed function origins are recorded separately.

sintef-2026-v3.title: Half-Cell Open-Circuit Voltage of Several Lithium-Ion Battery Active Materials Measured under Various Electrochemical Protocols
sintef-2026-v3.role: Raw measured half-cell time series and electrode metadata.

chen-validation-2020.title: Experimental data for "Development of Experimental Techniques for Parameterization of Multi-scale Lithium-ion Battery Models"
chen-validation-2020.role: Full-cell validation tests published alongside Chen2020; not proof of identical specimen to the dissected characterization cell.

bpx-lfp-2022.title: BPX LFP/graphite 2 Ah 18650 example
bpx-lfp-2022.role: Parameter example based on cycling and electrode teardown. Manufacturer, commercial part number, and matching raw cycling files are not disclosed in this example. Electrolyte and entropy data include borrowed sources.

lin-2022-paper.title: Multiscale coupling of surface temperature with solid diffusion in large lithium-ion pouch cells
lin-2022-paper.role: Table 1 fitted effective parameters at 30/50/70% SOC; Methods explicitly identify AMP20M1HD-A. Lumped diffusion time is shared by both electrodes.

lin-2022-data.title: Oxford experimental data for Lin et al. 2022
lin-2022-data.role: Original Cell I 4C full-discharge voltage, current, and thermal-grid observations. Source README explicitly permits redistribution under CC BY 4.0.

lin-2022-code.title: Oxford multiscale-coupling COMSOL/MATLAB implementation
lin-2022-code.role: Model geometry and assumed 5 micrometre particle radius. Optimizer initial guesses are not treated as final fitted parameters. Through-plane scaling is model specific.

oxford-9ah-data.title: Oxford high-power A123 LFP/graphite pouch-cell experiments
oxford-9ah-data.role: Ten CC charge/discharge experiments at 2/4/6/8/10C. The archive README supplies the 1 Hz timebase and license. The paper identifies A123 9 Ah; no part number is established.

oxford-9ah-paper.title: Electrochemical-thermal modelling of high power Li-ion pouch cells
oxford-9ah-paper.role: A123 9 Ah power pouch cell; the model assumes fast diffusion rather than identifying a finite diffusion coefficient. Its full-cell pseudo-OCP is allocated between electrodes as a modeling convention, not measured electrode OCPs.

marquis-2019.title: An asymptotic derivation of a single particle model with electrolyte
marquis-2019.role: Context of the Kokam SLPB78205130H parameter set. OCP, diffusion and kinetic function docstrings attribute their origin to Dualfoil; no same-cell measurement provenance is inferred.

dualfoil-attribution.title: Dualfoil electrode functions, as attributed by PyBaMM Marquis2019 and Ai2020
dualfoil-attribution.role: Borrowed mathematical function origin named in upstream modules; no same-cell measurement origin inferred.

mohtat-2020.title: Differential Expansion and Voltage Model for Li-ion Batteries at Practical Charging Rates
mohtat-2020.role: Same-study electrochemical/mechanical model and charging observations. Original author-code and PyBaMM implementation variants are distinguished; exact specimen and raw OCP/current/time exports remain unresolved.

kim-2011.title: Multi-domain modeling of lithium-ion batteries encompassing multi-physics in varied length scales
kim-2011.role: Nominal-design graphite/NCA parameter attribution. Commercial identity and matching raw full-cell data are unresolved. Thermal inputs in the implementation include borrowed/scaled Marquis values.

pybamm-data-1-0-2.title: PyBaMM experimental data release v1.0.2
authors: PyBaMM team; original experimental authors named per study
pybamm-data-1-0-2.role: Versioned redistribution. Experimental origins and figure-digitization history are documented in v1.0.0 release notes; v1.0.2 hashes match those files.

ecker-2015-i.title: Parameterization of a Physico-Chemical Model of a Lithium-Ion Battery: I. Determination of Parameters
ecker-2015-i.role: 7.5 Ah Kokam SLPB75106100 electrochemical characterization; model/fit lineage, not identical-specimen proof.

ecker-2015-ii.title: Parameterization of a Physico-Chemical Model of a Lithium-Ion Battery: II. Model Validation
ecker-2015-ii.role: Experimental origin attributed by PyBaMM's release notes for the digitized 1C/5C curves.

richardson-2020.title: Generalised single particle models for high-rate operation of graded lithium-ion electrodes: Systematic derivation and validation
richardson-2020.role: Figure 8 was digitized by upstream for the Ecker test files; fits supplied by Simon O'Kane are used in Ecker2015.py.

ai-2020.title: Electrochemical Thermal-Mechanical Modelling of Stress Inhomogeneity in Lithium-Ion Pouch Cells
ai-2020.role: Enertech pouch model; validates against Rieger observations. Diffusion/kinetics borrowing remains explicit.

rieger-2016.title: A new method to model the thickness change of a commercial pouch cell during discharge
rieger-2016.role: Experimental origin named by Ai2020 and official PyBaMM data notes; part number not independently verified.

mohtat-2020-data.title: UofM pouch cell voltage and expansion dataset and modeling code
mohtat-2020-data.role: Official author dataset downloaded through the normal browser on 2026-10-16. Five experimental charging MATs, four MATLAB model/plot files and README reviewed. Earlier automated HTTP 403 was an access-method failure. Packaged originals retain hashes and CC BY 4.0.

isu-uconn-2026-data.title: ISU-UConn LFP/Graphite Emulated Degradation Dataset
isu-uconn-2026-data.license_evidence: Primary deposit Terms of Use CC BY 4.0; pinned author README explicitly assigns this workbook to that dataset (checked 2026-10-17).
isu-uconn-2026-data.role: Laboratory CR2032 half/full-cell voltage-capacity observations. Author-hosted copy; byte identity to university download not established (HTTP 403).

isu-uconn-2026-code.title: REIL-UConn half-cell fitting notebook and loader
isu-uconn-2026-code.role: Selection and linkage evidence only; no author code executed or copied into project code. Dataset has separate CC BY 4.0 terms.

li-2026-benchmarking.title: Benchmarking half-cell model fitting approaches for lithium-ion battery degradation diagnostics
li-2026-benchmarking.role: Scientific study associated by primary deposit and author repository; full experimental procedures were not accessible in this import.

jahn-2024-data-v2.title: Probability distributed equivalent circuit model - Data (v2)
jahn-2024-data-v2.license_evidence: Packaged Zenodo API metadata metadata.license.id=cc-by-4.0; files verified against published MD5 and SHA-256.
jahn-2024-data-v2.role: Experimental whole-cell observations and modeled electrode OCPn arrays; these are different evidence types.

jahn-2024-code.title: Probability distributed equivalent circuit model - Code
jahn-2024-code.role: Original MATLAB inspected as text for coordinate, signs, column units and file linkage; never executed.

jahn-2024-paper.title: A physically motivated voltage hysteresis model for lithium-ion batteries using a probability distributed equivalent circuit
jahn-2024-paper.role: Methods names A123 18650M1A, 25 degC chamber, subsequent harvested-electrode tests and approximated OCPn parameterization.

hallemans-2025-repository.title: Hallemans2025 LG M50LT author data and scripts
hallemans-2025-repository.license_evidence: Pinned root LICENSE, Copyright (c) 2025 authors of journal paper, retained verbatim. Applied to author-owned measured data/results; no inferred grant for About:Energy third-party OCP inputs.
hallemans-2025-repository.role: Measured whole-cell EIS and drive cycle; fitted grouped-SPMe vector. Source code inspected as text, not executed.

hallemans-2025-paper-v4.title: Physics-based battery model parametrisation from impedance data
hallemans-2025-paper-v4.role: Table 2 definitions, Tables 4/5 EIS conditions and rounded fit, Section 7.3 measured drive-cycle interpretation. Earlier v3 is a different experiment/fit and is not combined.

pybop-25-6-grouped.title: PyBOP v25.6 grouped SPMe
